title: Intravenous Treatment of Anemia in Pregnancy
brief_summary: The investigators assess and compare the efficacy of anemia treatment in pregnant women with anemia of chronic disease with true iron deficiency and in women with iron deficiency anemia.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* pregnant women with hemoglobin between 8.0 and 9.9 g/dl and serum ferritin \<15 μg/l

Exclusion Criteria:

* vitamin B12 deficiency anemia
* folic acid deficiency anemia
* hemoglobinopathy
* multiples
* liver disease
* kidney disease
